test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the sixth term is related to the fifth term.

7183 ∶ 3850 ∶∶ 6957 ∶ ? ∶∶ 8972 ∶ 5639
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** First number - 3333 = Second number

 
• 7183 ∶ 3850 → 7183 - 3333 = 3850
 
• 8972 ∶ 5639 → 8972 - 3333 = 5639

Similarly,

 
• 6957 ∶ ? → 6957 - 3333 = 3624

Hence, '**3624**' is the correct answer.
